name: autotype-recorder
description: Intent-first cinematic code recording for VS Code

scripts.build: npm run check -w @autotype/core && npm run build -w @autotype/vscode-extension && npm run build -w @autotype/studio
scripts.test: npm run test -w @autotype/core && npm run test -w @autotype/studio
scripts.check: npm run check -w @autotype/core && npm run check -w @autotype/vscode-extension && npm run check -w @autotype/studio
